work_items.work_item_title: Integrate Design Checklists Into Sa Ta
work_items.scope_summary: Classify R-01 through R-34 and derive portable, conditional pre-design guidance for SA and TA without publishing HCP-specific content or moving s05 design/modeling authority upstream.
work_items.primary_outcome: A reviewed SA/TA checklist contract that is domain-neutral, confidentiality-safe, backward-compatible, bilingual, runtime-synchronized, and evidence-backed.
in_scope: Classify and privately trace all 34 source rules
Add portable SA/TA pre-design checks and downstream handoffs
Preserve the current output-schema, block-ownership, system-design, and architecture-modeling boundaries
Keep canonical EN/VI sources and both generated runtimes consistent
Add confidentiality, behavior, parity, reference, pack, compatibility, and UTF-8 verification
out_of_scope: Publishing HCP-specific system names, products, ownership decisions, exact thresholds, or verbatim internal content
Choosing stacks, products, patterns, schemas, domain boundaries, or models inside SA/TA
Publishing or globally installing a release before Release approval
